name: Jeffrey Deitch
about_text: Jeffrey Deitch is a contemporary art gallery founded by dealer, curator and writer Jeffrey Deitch, who opened its Los Angeles space in September 2018 after directing Deitch Projects in New York (1996–2010) and serving as director of MOCA Los Angeles. The gallery is known for ambitious thematic group shows such as People, Punch and Shattered Glass, alongside solo exhibitions with artists including Ai Weiwei, Judy Chicago, Urs Fischer, Robert Longo, Nari Ward and Rammellzee. Its program spans painting, sculpture, performance and street-art-influenced practices, continuing Deitch's long engagement with artists such as Keith Haring, Jean-Michel Basquiat and Jeff Koons. The gallery also maintains a New York space and participates actively in international art fairs.

triage.site_notes: The site is split by venue (los-angeles, new-york, special-projects) each with its own exhibitions/events/info sub-paths, plus a separate 'archive' section covering the historic Deitch Projects space and curatorial history, and a single unified /artists roster; duplicate content exists under both www and bare-domain hosts. No dedicated news or press page distinct from the per-location 'events' listings was found, and individual exhibition, artist, and fair sub-pages are largely redundant with their respective index/archive pages.
